raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Feb’20 – Feb’26: Senior Associate (Fund Accounting) | State Street Corporation, Hyderabad
Role:
❖ Orchestrated fund flow accounting, capturing investor subscriptions & redemptions (Capstock) to ensure accurate capital activity reporting. ❖ Executed accrual accounting for fund expenses through automated expense management systems, ensuring precision in P&L impact. ❖ Engineered interest accrual mechanisms for fixed-income portfolios leveraging Bloomberg analytics for yield optimization. ❖ Administered dividend processing and performed robust custody-accounting reconciliations to ensure data integrity (Dividend Validation). ❖ Conducted in-depth analysis and validation of corporate actions using Bloomberg and IDC, ensuring accurate lifecycle event processing. ❖ Computed TNA, updated prior-day pricing, assessed market value movements including depreciation/appreciation & buying power impact. ❖ Partnered with NAV production teams to deliver high-quality Daily NAVs within tight SLAs, ensuring regulatory compliance. ❖ ❖ Streamlined global trade settlement workflow via SWIFT, enhancing operational efficiency across middle- and back-office functions. ❖ Managed multi-asset trade processing across equities, fixed income, and derivatives spanning domestic (DTC/FED) and international
Implemented rigorous review controls to validate reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and audit readiness.
markets (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, HKD).
❖ Led trade lifecycle management including validation, enrichment, booking, amendments, and settlements aligned with client mandates. ❖ Collaborated with stakeholders (CDM, AMS, FA) within Research Review Team to resolve trade breaks and ensure timely reconciliation. ❖ Acted as liaison between traders, brokers, and custodians to ensure seamless trade matching and exception resolution. ❖ Conducted quality assurance reviews of junior deliverables to uphold operational excellence and minimize error rates. ❖ Maintained detailed MIS reports, audit trails, and operational logs to support governance and management reporting.
Highlights:
❖ Successfully led a project that resulted in reduction in processing time for fund transactions, improving client service delivery. ❖
Implemented a new quality control process that reduced errors in financial reporting, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and enhancing stakeholder trust.
❖ Led a team initiative that resulted in improvement in client satisfaction by enhanced communication and timely reporting of financial data. ❖ Collaborated with teams to develop a training program for new hires, resulting in decrease in onboarding time. ❖ Spearheaded initiatives that led to reduction in trade discrepancies, improving the efficiency of trade processing operations. ❖ Successfully mentored a team of 3 to 5 junior associates, enhancing their skills in fund accounting and trade processing. ❖ Played a pivotal role in enhancing client relationships by providing timely, resulting in increase in client retention. ❖ Delivered accurate and timely reporting to offshore clients, including direct interaction with a Boston-based client. ❖ Acted as a primary liaison between clients and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and issue resolution. ❖ Provided training and mentorship to junior team members, improving team productivity and process understanding. ❖ Played a key role in process improvements and error reduction initiatives within fund accounting workflow.
Aug’19 – Jan’20: Equity Research Analyst | Karvy Stock Broking Limited, Hyderabad
Role:
❖ Delivered high-impact investment advisory services, managing diversified client portfolios exceeding $50M across asset classes. ❖ Performed advanced fundamental and technical analysis to generate alpha, achieving ~12% average portfolio returns. ❖ Executed equity trades across primary and secondary markets while ensuring adherence to stringent risk and compliance frameworks.
Jun’18 – Jul’19: Investment Analyst | State Street Syntel Services, Pune
Role:
❖ Managed daily reconciliation of cash and securities, ensuring seamless trade settlement and exception management. ❖ Conducted performance attribution and investment analytics for APAC clients, enhancing reporting accuracy by 20%. ❖ Administered FX transactions and developed customized financial reports for high-net-worth clients to support strategic decision-making.
